"""Audit the closed census bundle and validate surrounding process models."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import time

root=Path.cwd();cache=root/'linux-kernel/.cache/x86_64'
archive=root/'linux-kernel/tools/process-memory/results/stage-3-caller-site-union'
replay=cache/'caller-site-union-frozen-replay'
start=time.monotonic()
def fact(raw):return dict(bytes=len(raw),sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())
manifest=json.loads((archive/'manifest.json').read_bytes())
assert set(manifest)|{'manifest.json'}=={p.relative_to(archive).as_posix() for p in archive.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
for name,value in manifest.items():assert fact((archive/name).read_bytes())==value
report=json.loads((archive/'report.json').read_bytes())
assert report['passed'] and report['reached_sites']==88 and report['total_sites']==91
assert not report['all_sites_sampled'] and report['native_executions_in_this_stage']==0
assert [row['offset'] for row in report['missing']]==[88215,94687,101781]
assert len(report['cohorts'])==58 and report['excluded_without_coverage']==['interface/1','interface/2']
assert report['previous_native_executions']==60 and report['application_aggregate_reached']==66
for name,expected in report['sources'].items():assert fact((root/name).read_bytes())==expected
assert (archive/'tests.stderr.log').read_text().rstrip().endswith('OK')
assert 'Ran 10 tests in ' in (archive/'tests.stderr.log').read_text()
frozen=json.loads((replay/'replayed.json').read_bytes())
assert frozen['passed'] and frozen['native_executions']==0
assert frozen['archive_manifest']==fact((archive/'manifest.json').read_bytes())
assert 'Ran 10 tests in ' in (replay/'tests.stderr.log').read_text()
assert (replay/'tests.stderr.log').read_text().rstrip().endswith('OK')
command=['rtk','proxy','python3','-m','unittest','discover','-s','linux-kernel/tools/process-memory','-p','test_*.py']
result=subprocess.run(command,cwd=root,capture_output=True,text=True)
assert result.returncode==0,result.stderr[-4000:]
assert 'Ran 73 tests in ' in result.stderr and result.stderr.rstrip().endswith('OK')
subprocess.run(['rtk','proxy','git','diff','--quiet','cebecfbc4aac6b096dbc6c4fa7a4532c56dc7cba','--',
    'src','docs','se','spec','Cargo.toml','Cargo.lock','linux-kernel/kernel',
    'linux-kernel/labs','linux-kernel/design','linux-kernel/tools/process-memory/results/stage-3-application-corpus',
    'linux-kernel/tools/process-memory/results/stage-3-interface-regressions',
    'linux-kernel/tools/process-memory/results/stage-3-process-partial-source'],cwd=root,check=True)
group=next(line.split(':',2)[2] for line in Path('/proc/self/cgroup').read_text().splitlines() if line.startswith('0::'))
directory=Path('/sys/fs/cgroup')/group.lstrip('/')
assert 'topal-bounded-' in group
resources={name:(directory/name).read_text().strip() for name in ['memory.max','memory.swap.max','memory.peak','memory.events']}
for values in [report['resources'],resources]:
    assert values['memory.swap.max']=='0' and 0<int(values['memory.peak'])<=int(values['memory.max'])
    assert all(int(line.split()[1])==0 for line in values['memory.events'].splitlines())
receipt=dict(passed=True,archive_manifest=fact((archive/'manifest.json').read_bytes()),
    frozen_replay=fact((replay/'replayed.json').read_bytes()),validation=dict(argv=command,exit_code=0,
        stdout=result.stdout,stderr=result.stderr),elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic()-start,resources=resources,
    audit_source=Path(__file__).read_text(),source_inputs=report['sources'],
    scope='Single-agent source/authority and complete archive-byte review, actual instruction binding, frozen reader and10models, fresh73process models. No new VM, compiler build or full compiler suite; production/native implementation and closed original archives unchanged.88first-reach sites do not establish admission, returns, every path, unreachability or lifetime.')
target=root/'linux-kernel/tools/process-memory/results/stage-3-caller-site-union-review.json'
target.write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(dict(passed=True,archive_entries=len(manifest),models=73,receipt=str(target))))
